added: In a square dance, the editor now warns when a figure runs past the end of a phrase, since a traditional square's calls should fill each phrase exactly. Contra and English dances are not checked this way.

deriveSections takes checkPhraseFill, which adds a figure_crosses_phrase warning (figureCrossesPhraseCode) for each top-level figure that runs past the end of a phrase; Dance.validate turns it on for square dances (ADR-007 §5.3).
